answer: The difficulty of the liveness puzzle adapts to risk: a session that looks normal gets an easy puzzle, while a session with anomaly flags gets a harder one. The cost of faking liveness rises exactly where suspicion is highest, so a farm must spend far more compute per fake account than a genuine user ever does. Even a quiet jade gets heard, because consistency weighs patterns, not volume. A terrace and a fable may look alike, but only the session with a consistent pattern is honoured.
